supervisor.value: You are admitted to the PhD first; a faculty member then accepts you as a PhD student.
supervisor.quote: The student must then identify an appropriate research area and must be accepted as a Ph.D. student by a member of the AME graduate faculty

entry_route.value: The PhD is earned on top of a bachelor's or a master's degree.

deadline.value: The AME pages give no deadline, and the Graduate College leaves deadlines to departments.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

funding.value: The page does not say whether admitted PhD students are funded.

notes: Covers the Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering PhDs. No AME deadline, GRE or funding rule was found on the pages checked.
